trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: State application ID and ask for a fee waiver.
steps.text: నమస్కారం, నా application ID APP-2004. నాకు fees లో weaver కావాలి. అసలు waiver అంటే ఏంటి?

steps.purpose: Explain waiver and ask for verification details.
steps.text: నమస్కారం అండి. Waiver అంటే fee లో తగ్గింపు లేదా discount. నేను మీ account details check చేసి చెప్తాను. ముందుగా మీ registered name మరియు date of birth చెప్పగలరా?

steps.purpose: Provide verification details, repeating the required fields.
steps.text: నా పేరు మరియు పుట్టిన తేదీ చెప్పాలా? సరే, నా పేరు సురేష్, date of birth 12th May 2001.

steps.purpose: Verify customer identity.
Return verification outcome.
Look up fee account details.
Return fee account details.
State the fee details and scholarship.
steps.text: ధన్యవాదాలు సురేష్ గారు. మీ account లో ఇప్పటికే 10% scholarship apply అయ్యింది. మీ total fee 420000, అందులో 100000 కట్టారు. ఇంకా 320000 due ఉంది.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the due amount and ask for a discount.
steps.text: అవును, 320000 కట్టాలి. కానీ నాకు కొంచెం discount ఇస్తారా? నేను అంత ఒకేసారి కట్టలేను.

steps.purpose: Refuse the waiver as per policy.
steps.text: క్షమించండి, దీని మీద వేరే waiver లేదా discount ఇవ్వడం కుదరదు అండి. మన policy ప్రకారం scholarship మాత్రమే వర్తిస్తుంది.

steps.purpose: Threaten to cancel admission and ask for refund amount.
steps.text: వేరే discount రాదా? అయితే నేను నా admission cancel చేసుకుంటాను. నాకు ఎంత refund వస్తుందో చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Check the refund slab for the withdrawal.
Return refund slab details.
Explain the refund terms based on the tool result.
steps.text: మీరు admission తీసుకుని 3 weeks అయ్యింది కాబట్టి, మన policy ప్రకారం మీకు 50% refund వస్తుంది. అంటే 50000 refundable amount, ఇది 14 processing days లో వస్తుంది.

steps.purpose: Express dissatisfaction with the refund amount and processing time.
steps.text: 14 days పడుతుందా? పైగా కేవలం 50000 మాత్రమే వస్తుందా?

steps.purpose: Confirm the refund amount calculation.
steps.text: అవునండి, మీరు కట్టిన 100000 లో 50% అంటే 50000 మాత్రమే refund వస్తుంది.

steps.purpose: Decide not to cancel and ask about instalments.
steps.text: అయితే నేను cancel చేసుకోను. ఈ 320000 due ని నేను instalments లో కట్టవచ్చా?

steps.purpose: Offer available instalment options.
steps.text: అవునండి, మీరు 2, 3, లేదా 4 instalments లో కట్టవచ్చు. మీకు ఎన్ని instalments కావాలి?

steps.purpose: Request 4 instalments.
Acknowledge the request and indicate plan setup.
steps.text: మీరు 4 instalments అడుగుతున్నారు కదా, ఒక్క నిమిషం నేను మీ plan setup చేస్తాను.

steps.purpose: Set up the 4-instalment plan.
Return the setup instalment plan details.
Confirm the plan activation and state the per-instalment amount.
steps.text: నేను మీ 4 instalments plan active చేశాను. ఒక్కో instalment కి మీరు 80000 కట్టాలి. మీ plan ID PLAN-8899.

steps.purpose: Repeat the instalment amount to confirm understanding.
steps.text: ఒక్కో దానికి 80000 కట్టాలా? సరే, నేను రాసుకుంటాను. 80000 per instalment. నేను త్వరలో మొదటి instalment కడతాను.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and ask if further assistance is needed.
steps.text: మంచిది సురేష్ గారు. మీ plan ఇప్పుడు active గా ఉంది, కాబట్టి మీరు ఎప్పుడైనా కట్టవచ్చు. ఇంకేమైనా సహాయం కావాలా?

steps.purpose: Decline further help, ending the conversation.
steps.text: ఇంకేమీ లేదు, నాకు కావలసిన వివరాలు తెలిసాయి.

ir.terminal_condition: Instalment plan active with the per-instalment amount stated from the result.
primary_variant_labels: Tool Use > Tool Selection > Correct Tool Selection
secondary_variant_labels: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

variant_findings.reason: The user asks for the refund amount, and the agent correctly selects check_refund_slab among other available tools like lookup_fee_account.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Selection > Correct Tool Selection

variant_findings.reason: The agent consistently uses the exact figures returned by the tools (e.g., 10% scholarship, 50% refund, 50000 refundable amount, 80000 per instalment) without inventing any details or making ungrounded forward guarantees.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e7, the lookup_fee_account tool returns `instalments_active: true`. However, the user later states they cannot pay the due all at once and asks to set up an instalment plan, which the agent proceeds to do. If instalments were already active, this flow would be contradictory.
issues.repair_instruction: Change `instalments_active` to `false` in the tool result at e7 so it logically aligns with the user's subsequent request to set up a new instalment plan.

issues.detail: The requested STT profile is LIGHT, but there are no speech recognition errors or corrupted spans in any of the user's turns.
issues.repair_instruction: Introduce minor phonetic or spelling errors in the user's `model_visible_text` (and update `corrupted_span` and `stt_error_type` accordingly) for at least one or two turns to reflect the LIGHT STT profile.

verification.summary: The conversation perfectly realizes both target variants, with correct tool selection and excellent grounding of tool outputs. The persona is well-represented, and the language mixing is natural. However, there is a minor logical contradiction where the initial fee lookup indicates instalments are already active, but the user later asks to set up a new instalment plan. Additionally, the requested LIGHT STT profile was not applied to the user's speech.
